name: Authentication & Student Dashboard Navigation
description: Verifies instant demo login, session state persistence, and switching between platform view tabs.

planSteps.description: Open the home page and click 'Instant Demo Login (Rahul Sharma - IIIT)' button
Assert that the student dashboard is displayed and user name shows 'Rahul Sharma'
Click 'AI Skill Analysis' in the navigation sidebar
Assert that the skill gap radar and required competency metrics are visible
Click 'Personal Roadmap' in the navigation sidebar
Assert that weekly study hours and roadmap milestones are rendered
